tent_styles.name: Pole Tents
tent_styles.description: Traditional center-pole construction creates recognizable peaks and an open, festive silhouette. Best installed on grass where the full staking pattern can be used.

tent_styles.name: Frame Tents
tent_styles.description: An aluminum frame supports the roof without center poles, giving you a clear interior and more placement flexibility on lawns, patios, or driveways.

tent_styles.name: High-Peak Frame Tents
tent_styles.description: A frame-supported tent with a lifted center peak. It delivers a finished event look in smaller footprints without placing a support pole in the guest area.

tent_styles.name: Sailcloth Tents
tent_styles.description: Translucent sailcloth, rounded ends, and sculpted peaks create warm daytime light and a soft glow after dark. These tents require suitable ground for staking.

tent_styles.name: Clear-Top Frame Tents
tent_styles.description: Transparent vinyl roof panels preserve the pole-free frame-tent interior while opening the view overhead. Shade planning is important for warm daytime events.

tent_styles.name: Clearspan Structure Tents
tent_styles.description: A heavy-duty aluminum structure creates a wide, unobstructed interior. Available configurations may include tensioned roof panels, rigid PVC or glass walls, doors, and integrated flooring.

tent_styles.name: Party Canopies
tent_styles.description: Straightforward overhead cover for casual gatherings where a full event tent is not necessary. An approachable option for smaller guest lists and simple layouts.

pricing_note: Starting prices are editable planning estimates for the template and may not include delivery, installation, permits, sidewalls, flooring, lighting, taxes, or site-specific labor. Final capacity depends on table style, dance floors, catering areas, and local requirements.
